label: Case reference
type_unit: id (CASE-REF-nnnn)
notes: The handle the customer quotes to support; shown on every surface

label: Policyholder name
type_unit: text
notes: Field shows it with the shop; referral agents see the customer name with stage and sub-status only (FLD-008)

label: Case sub-status
type_unit: enum: open | on hold | rework | declined | cancelled | lapsed
notes: Production vocabulary (D-001). Harbor renders it in plain words. Never declined on a provider failure; PROVIDER-FAILED is a queue-row flag and the sub-status stays open or rework (PRD R9)

label: Risk tier
type_unit: enum: 1 | 2 | 3
notes: Engine output. Shown to staff and never to the customer (context/policies/risk-tiers-and-routing.md)

label: Queue clock against the service level
type_unit: hours elapsed of the commitment (24 h verification; 12 h rework re-check; example)
current_storage: derived — h_verification.queued_at and h_rework_item.resubmitted_at against the configured service level
notes: Harbor shows the customer wording only (within one working day). PRD R7: a return stops the verification clock; a resubmission starts the re-check clock; PROVIDER-FAILED pauses it and a clock a return stopped stays stopped. Policy: context/policies/service-levels.md; whether production pauses the clock is not established

label: Manual verification method
type_unit: enum from the configured list: document inspection (default) | video call (open input) | field visit (open input)
notes: PRD R9: recorded after the retry limit; the method list is owned by the compliance officer. Regulated evidence: manual method where used (context/regulated-actions.md). h_audit_event.metadata cannot hold it while it is empty (context/05-numbers-data-and-traps.md trap 2)

label: Checklist item
type_unit: enum from the checklist for product and shop type
notes: Items and conditions: context/policies/document-checklist.md

label: Document status
type_unit: enum: received | accepted | unreadable | mismatched | missing
notes: received is set on upload (HUB-007); the rest by the officer (context/04-eligibility-and-verification.md)

label: Document reference
type_unit: id (DOC-REF-nnnn) with version
notes: A replacement is a new version of the same reference; the rework item points at it

label: Capture tip for the item
type_unit: text per checklist item
current_storage: config — the Field slot text (what the officer needs to see; FLD-002)
notes: Exists for Field slots. The feature shows the same text on Harbor rework items and in the Desk reason picker

label: Why the insurer needs the item
type_unit: text per checklist item
current_storage: config — document checklist column (why the insurer needs it)
notes: Shown in full before the first upload (HUB-004); repeated on a missing item (PRD R3)

label: Accepted alternative documents
type_unit: list of checklist documents per item
notes: PRD R3: every returned item lists them. context/policies/document-checklist.md names no alternatives today; the list is document-checklist policy

label: Reason code
type_unit: enum: unreadable | mismatched | missing
notes: Required on return (DESK-004). A verifier may mark inspection items rework (FLD-006)

label: Field that differs on a mismatched item
type_unit: enum of case-record fields: policyholder name | shop address | date of birth
notes: The gap named in HUB-008 and DESK-004. Visible to the customer; the support agent; the verification officer and the assigned field verifier (PRD R12). Items raised before the feature have no value: Desk shows "not recorded" and never a blank

label: What the record says for the differing field
type_unit: text (the case value)
current_storage: derived — the h_case or h_customer column named by RWK-02
notes: Lets the customer fix the document or the record once

label: Rule that fired
type_unit: configured rule name and the input that triggered it
notes: Exists on the case view (DESK-003). The feature names it on the rework item. The customer never sees the configured rule name (PRD R2); Harbor shows the requirement in plain words (RWK-17)

label: Customer-facing reason text
type_unit: text in the customer language (h_customer.language)
current_storage: config — message template per reason code and language
notes: Templates exist per stage and language (context/03-surfaces-and-systems.md). Carries what happened and what it means for the policy. Templates only; the officer's note stays internal (PRD R2). Asks nothing new without consent (context/regulated-actions.md)

label: Next step for the customer
type_unit: enum: re-upload on Harbor | field verifier captures on site (visit) | correct the detail | ask our team to take another look
notes: Exists (HUB-008). Paths per reason (PRD R4): visit default unreadable and missing; never mismatched; correct the detail on mismatched; take another look on mismatched and any second return. Talk to our team is on every message and is not an item path

label: Days left before the case goes on hold
type_unit: days remaining of the window (7 days; example)
current_storage: derived — h_rework_item.raised_at plus the configured window
notes: PRD R8: per item from each round; restarts on a second return; pauses from a visit request until the capture; keeps running on a provider failure (context/policies/service-levels.md)

label: Open rework items on the case
type_unit: count
current_storage: derived — h_rework_item rows per case not yet accepted
notes: PRD R10: open from raise until the officer records accepted. Desk shows this count with RWK-13 beside it. Harbor and Field show the items with no resubmission (open minus RWK-13) as N of M still to send. The Field route shows it (FLD-001)

label: Replacement capture status
type_unit: enum: not started | pending send | replacement sent | attached | accepted
notes: FLD-004 pending send; FLD-005 replacement sent; DESK-006 attached; accepted closes the item (PRD §8 item states). Harbor words: not received | visit being arranged | received — being re-checked | done

label: Resolvable on site by the field verifier
type_unit: yes | no per reason code
notes: PRD R4 default: unreadable and missing yes; mismatched no. Owner: ops lead (D-006 PENDING)

label: Return round on an item
type_unit: round number with raised and resubmitted times per round
notes: PRD R10: one rework item per document; each return is a round. A second return opens a new round on the same item and tells the customer what changed (A14)

label: Visit request and expected day
type_unit: request time; expected day (date)
notes: PRD R5 and A6 (Should): creates a replacement-capture task for the region's field verifier or joins the existing inspection task; the customer may change the day; an upload first closes the task

label: Items awaiting re-check
type_unit: count
current_storage: derived — h_rework_item rows per case with resubmitted_at set and the item not yet accepted
notes: PRD R10: an item awaits re-check once a resubmission arrives; Desk shows the count beside the open count (A3)

label: Corrected detail
type_unit: field; old value; new value; who (role); time
notes: PRD R6 and A15: the customer on the own case or a verification officer at the customer's request. A resubmission at confirmation; re-runs the rules and for name or date of birth the identity check. Evidence owner: compliance officer

label: Visit switch per region
type_unit: on | off per region
notes: PRD R5: the ops lead switches the visit path off per region when inspection tasks pass the field inspection service level (72 hours; example). Off: the visit path is not offered

label: Lapse date
type_unit: date
notes: PRD R8 and A16: the date the case lapses after 30 days (example) on hold; shown in the on-hold message. Where the on-hold time is stored is not established

label: Requirement in plain words
type_unit: text per reason code and language
notes: PRD R3: mismatched — the rule that fired (RWK-04) in plain words; unreadable — what must be visible on the item; missing — on the checklist with why the insurer needs it (DOC-05). No template: the reason text shows alone and the gap is reported to the customer lane

label: Identity-check provider result
type_unit: enum: verified | not matched | provider-failed
notes: Timeout 90 s (example). provider-failed never declines; the case goes to the retry queue (context/04-eligibility-and-verification.md)

label: Retry attempts against the limit
type_unit: count of attempts and the configured limit (two retries so three attempts; example)
notes: PRD R9 and §7: attempt count new; the retry limit is the ops lead's (D-007). Automatic retries depend on the retry queue (C4)

label: Manual verification result
type_unit: enum: verified | not matched
notes: PRD R9 and A10: recorded with the method (VER-04) after the retry limit. not matched returns the identity proof as mismatched with the field; the case is not declined for it. Values owned by the compliance officer

label: Regulated action
type_unit: enum: identity verification | consent and disclosure | record retention | cooling-off | claim acknowledgement | complaint handling
notes: One row per action on the case (DESK-009). The actions and their evidence: context/regulated-actions.md

label: Actor role
type_unit: enum of roles
notes: Roles and never names

label: Event time
type_unit: timestamp
notes: Shown beside the actor role (DESK-009)

label: Evidence reference
type_unit: id: provider response reference | document reference | consent text version
notes: Links to the evidence record (DESK-009). The provider response reference is the evidence for identity verification

label: Consent record
type_unit: consent text version; time; channel; language
current_storage: h_audit_event rows with action consent: evidence_ref and occurred_at; channel and language were in metadata
notes: metadata has been empty since the August release (context/05-numbers-data-and-traps.md trap 2) so channel and language evidence has no current path. The customer sees what was agreed and when and on which channel (A12); on Desk the compliance officer only. A record from before the feature shows "not recorded". Owner: compliance officer

label: Delete-after date
type_unit: date
current_storage: derived — h_policy.end_at plus 7 years; unissued cases: last customer action plus 2 years (example)
notes: Per record type (PRD R13); visible to the compliance officer and the ops lead. Record retention evidence (context/regulated-actions.md). Backfilled for cases that exist before the feature lands

label: Identity number
type_unit: text; last 4 characters (example) outside the verification screen
notes: Full value on the Desk verification screen only; never on Field or to the referral agent. Each view of the full value is an audit event (PRD R12; context/policies/data-handling-and-retention.md)

label: Message text version
type_unit: id of the template version sent
notes: PRD A11: on the rework evidence record with the requirement shown. Distinct from the consent text version (AUD-04 and AUD-05)
